description: Resume a Universal Manifold Controller Long Play from its latest sealed tip (local cache first, then the NATS KV bucket UMC_LONG_PLAY) for the given domain, session_id and node_id; direct=true advances one turn after resuming. GRANT CLASS MESH: requires a caller identity (user_vqbit_hash 32 lowercase hex, entity_id or wallet_hash) or the call is REFUSED_GRANT_MESH_IDENTITY_REQUIRED. Measured 2026-09-02 with an identity: status CALORIE_GAV_LONG_PLAY_RESUME and the same tip shape as umc_direct (turn_index, tau_height, torsion_num/torsion_den, amplitudes, invariant_root_hex). Use umc_direct to create or advance a session; use this to pick up where a previous call, tab or cell left off.

direct.description: true: after resuming, advance one turn (equivalent to one umc_direct call). e.g. true

domain.description: the domain the session was started under

entity_id.description: caller identity, alternative to user_vqbit_hash: the wallet_geo entity id hex, e.g. 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff

node_id.description: the session node: any stable string naming the client or tab that plays this session, e.g. ide-tab-1. This is NOT the caller identity; identity is user_vqbit_hash, entity_id or wallet_hash

session_id.description: the session id given to umc_direct. e.g. r5-session-1

user_vqbit_hash.description: caller identity, one of the three this MESH-class tool accepts: exactly 32 lowercase hex, e.g. 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef. Send user_vqbit_hash, entity_id or wallet_hash or the call is REFUSED_GRANT_MESH_IDENTITY_REQUIRED (the refusal names the field under need)

wallet_hash.description: caller identity, alternative to user_vqbit_hash: sha256 of the caller wallet, lowercase hex, e.g. 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08

name: umc_resume
